L01.why: S3: 'every' is in the seed ('She won't listen to every word you say') and no LEGO carries it; L01 'listen' is the seed's only LEGO, so it grows to 'listen to every word' (6 syllables, ungapped, a piece of the seed). The Urdu is the seed's own ہر بات … سننا; the old known side (دھیان سے سننا) matched none of the rows.

B02: listen to every word you say
U02: کیا آپ ہر بات سن سکتے ہیں؟
can you listen to every word?
U03: میں آپ کی ہر بات سننا چاہتا ہوں
I want to listen to every word you say
U04: I should listen to every word

notes: cs #813: re-cut: 'listen' -> 'listen to every word'. U01 and U05 already contain it. This also closes the 'every' half of S0584's gap (with S0108 for 'wake', S0584 needs no change). Cost: 'listen to me' and 'listen carefully' go.
